n = int(input())
B = int(input())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
evenCount = 0
oddCount = 0
import heapq
queue = []

for i in range(n):
    if arr[i] % 2 == 0:
        evenCount += 1
    else:
        oddCount += 1
    if evenCount == oddCount and i < n - 1:
        heapq.heappush(queue, abs(arr[i + 1] - arr[i]))

sum_pairs = 0
countPairs = 0
while queue and sum_pairs + queue[0] <= B:
    sum_pairs += heapq.heappop(queue)
    countPairs += 1

print(countPairs)
